title: Grindline: 149 Skateboard Sound Effects
shortText: 149 skateboard sounds: rolling loops on 6 surfaces, pops, grinds, landings.
html:
Grindline is 149 skateboard sound effects for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and any game engine, with 29 seamless loops in WAV and OGG.

One board and the places it rides: pushing off, rolling on 6 surfaces at 3 speeds, the ollie pop by charge, landings by drop height, grinds, slides, manuals and the bail. Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 14 sounds is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_a_run.gif@@

What is inside

149 sounds · 29 seamless loops · 9 ladders · 11 grinds, slides and manuals · WAV + OGG · 14 sound free demo

  • Push and roll (44 files, 18 loops): pushes, the board rolling on concrete bowl, smooth concrete, wooden ramp, slab pavement, rough asphalt and steel plate ramp at slow, cruising and fast speeds, carves, kickturns, powerslides, brakes and a pebble stop.
  • Tricks (26): the ollie pop as a 5 step strength ladder, nollies, kickflips, heelflips, shove its, catches, grabs and a flip whoosh by spin speed.
  • Landings (21): a 5 step drop height ladder from a curb to a big gap, clean and sketchy landings, primo, tail drag, drop ins and reverts.
  • Grinds and slides (24, 8 loops): a square rail, a round handrail, a waxed ledge, pipe coping and a painted curb, plus three board slides, each an enter, a loop and an exit.
  • Manuals and wall rides (11): manuals, nose manuals and a wall ride, each an enter, a loop and an exit.
  • Bails and the board (23): bails on concrete, wood and metal, the board clattering, rolling away and landing back on its wheels.

@@IMG:shot_5_grinds_and_slides.png@@

Works with

Unity, Unreal, Godot 4, GameMaker, RPG Maker and HTML5: use the WAV or OGG files directly. Loop points are written into every loop file. Import notes are in the readme.

Try it free

The demo holds a push, two rolling loops, a kickflip, one rail grind from enter to exit, three ollie pops, three landings and a bail.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code, with no generative audio model, samples or recordings. The code and the cover were made with AI tools. There is no music and there are no voices.

More from the same studio

  • Footfall: Footstep Sound Effects, feet on twelve surfaces, for when the rider steps off.
  • Kickoff: Ball Sports Sound Effects, for the rest of the sports game.
  • Pit Lane: Racing Sound Effects, engines and tyres for anything with a motor.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
